question: How is the prepared sandalwood empowered to bring someone under control?
premises: The substance is consecrated with mantra.
The mantra is repeated one hundred and eight times.
The result is bringing someone under control.
inference: After consecrating it with one hundred and eight mantra repetitions, one can bring the target under control.
plain_english: After consecrating it with one hundred and eight repetitions of the mantra, one can bring the target under control.
